capabilities.text: Integrate with Epic as the source of truth for clinical notes
capabilities.quote: The new tool must integrate with two existing systems: Epic (as the source of truth for clinical notes)

capabilities.text: Integrate with SharePoint Online for ward notes
capabilities.quote: and SharePoint Online (where the ward notes are currently duplicated).

capabilities.text: Read note data from Epic using FHIR API
capabilities.quote: I’ll use Epic’s FHIR API to read the note data after it’s saved

capabilities.text: Write note data to SharePoint using REST API
capabilities.quote: and the SharePoint REST API to write the note to the designated worksheet.

capabilities.text: Authenticate connections using Azure AD
capabilities.quote: We’ll authenticate both connections using Azure AD

capabilities.text: Implement a service principal with limited permissions
capabilities.quote: and I’ll implement a service principal with limited permissions scoped to the specific EHR and SharePoint sites.

capabilities.text: Support up to 10 concurrent users per ward
capabilities.quote: I’ll design the tool to support up to 10 concurrent users per ward

capabilities.text: Enforce role-based access control through Azure AD groups
capabilities.quote: with role-based access control enforced through Azure AD groups.

capabilities.text: Build the tool using C# and .NET 8
capabilities.quote: the core components will be written in C# using .NET 8

capabilities.text: Host the tool as an Azure Function
capabilities.quote: hosted as an Azure Function behind an API Management gateway.

capabilities.text: Use a CI/CD pipeline in Azure DevOps
capabilities.quote: We’ll use a CI/CD pipeline in Azure DevOps

capabilities.text: Perform unit testing with xUnit
capabilities.quote: unit testing with xUnit

capabilities.text: Enforce compliance with Azure Policy
capabilities.quote: and Azure Policy enforcement for compliance.

capabilities.text: Launch the tool from an Epic custom button
capabilities.quote: a nurse should be able to open the tool directly from the Epic care environment via a custom button

capabilities.text: Automatically populate the note text from Epic
capabilities.quote: the tool automatically populates the note text from the most recently saved clinical note in Epic

capabilities.text: Display the note in a clean, editable field
capabilities.quote: displays it in a clean, editable field, and allows her to review or edit it.

capabilities.text: Write the edited note to SharePoint Online
capabilities.quote: the tool writes the note to the designated worksheet in the shared SharePoint Online file

capabilities.text: Include metadata (timestamp, nurse ID, patient ID) in SharePoint write
capabilities.quote: including metadata like timestamp, nurse ID (from Azure AD), and patient ID.

capabilities.text: Complete the entire flow in under 90 seconds
capabilities.quote: The entire flow completes in under 90 seconds, with no manual retyping.

capabilities.text: Write the edited version of the note to SharePoint
capabilities.quote: The edited version is what gets written to the worksheet—this is essential for accuracy and workflow efficiency.

capabilities.text: Support only Epic FHIR and SharePoint Online integration in version one
capabilities.quote: I’ll scope version one to support only Epic FHIR and SharePoint Online integration, with no additional file formats or multi-ward support.

capabilities.text: Embed a custom button in the Epic Care Management module
capabilities.quote: We’ll embed a custom button in the Epic Care Management module using Epic’s FHIR-based integration framework

capabilities.text: Pass patient MRN and encounter ID as query parameters from Epic button
capabilities.quote: The button will be visible only to nurses on Ward 4B, and it will pass the patient’s MRN and encounter ID as query parameters to the tool.

capabilities.text: Budget range of $25,000 to $35,000 for the full build
capabilities.quote: There’s a budget range: $25,000 to $35,000 for the full build, including development, testing, deployment, and documentation.

capabilities.text: Azure running cost under $2,000/year
capabilities.quote: and a small allowance for Azure resource costs (under $2,000/year).
